info.name: EcoTrack Microservices
info.description:
Complete API collection for EcoTrack Microservices - Environmental Monitoring & Sustainability Management System. All requests go through API Gateway on port 8090.

## Setup:
1. Register a user
2. Login and copy the token
3. Set the `token` variable with your JWT token
4. All authenticated requests will use it automatically

request.description:
Log a new emission. Status defaults to SUBMITTED.

⚠️ Duplicate check: Same industryName + type combination is rejected with HTTP 409.

response.name: 409 - Duplicate
400 - Validation Error

request.description: Fetch a single emission log by its ID.
Fetch all emissions for a company by industryName. Supports names with spaces (e.g. Steel Industries).

Update emission status. Transitions:
- SUBMITTED → APPROVED
- SUBMITTED → REJECTED
- APPROVED/REJECTED → terminal (no further change)
Delete an emission log by ID.
